about.title: Pittsburg Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription:
When someone dies because another person was careless, the paperwork arrives before the grief has settled. In 2025, public records for Pittsburg list 3 traffic deaths, alongside 170 injury collisions and 237 people hurt, with the highest counts recorded along SR-4, Railroad Avenue and Harbor Street. Each number is a Contra Costa County household that changed overnight.

A wrongful death claim in California is a civil case, separate from anything the district attorney may pursue. It exists so that a spouse, domestic partner, children, or in some situations other dependents and heirs can recover funeral and burial costs, the income the person would have provided, and the harder-to-measure loss of love, companionship and guidance. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shrinks when a public agency is involved.

LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Pittsburg families with an independent personal injury attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Pittsburg Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing, giving priority to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children before certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family has the right to bring the claim before any time is lost.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched closely
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is much shorter when a city, county or state agency is a potential defendant. Being connected early means those deadlines get calendared, not discovered too late.

items.title: Every category of loss is accounted for
items.desc: Recoverable losses go beyond funeral and burial expenses to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, so pursuing the full claim never depends on what your family can pay up front.

items.question: My loved one was killed in a crash on SR-4 in Pittsburg. Does it matter that it's a state highway?
items.answer: It can. If the condition of the roadway itself played a role, a public entity such as Caltrans may be a potential defendant, and claims against government agencies in California must be presented on a much shorter timeline than the standard two years. An attorney can evaluate whether that applies and act on it quickly. The other driver's responsibility is assessed separately.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs independently of any criminal prosecution, and the outcomes of the two are not tied together. Your family can move forward regardless of what happens in the criminal court, and evidence from that case can sometimes help.
